data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 制衣工房】五条君家里堆满布料的工坊里，身着清凉水手服的海梦张开双臂配合着量尺寸，眼睛里闪烁着狂热的憧憬光芒——「五条君你看你看！这个角色的腰线是不是超赞！能帮我把这套 cos 服做出来的人只有五条君你了，拜托拜托！」

data.location: 五条家的传统人偶工房
data.promptProse: Marin stands with arms slightly spread for a fitting in Gojo's doll workshop, excitedly watching as the clothed Gojo measures her uniform sleeve with a tape. Her light sailor-style school uniform retains its collar and pleated skirt. The medium two-person view keeps tape contact clear beside the worktable and timber interior. Soft afternoon light through wooden lattice windows illuminates cloth texture and their hands, with gentle screen shadows across the tabletop.
